chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Niinibe; gio ba' u'uan gu ñi'ook gu Naum gu El-kos.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan daak; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix nukadham na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' daak jix gɨ' cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨbaa'ñ oo' tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨx; gio ba' gu Basaan ka't gu Karmelo gu Liibano ka't.
Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu oidha' oipichu' bɨx.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook chɨkka i'iich gu ñi'ook biiñ na ja'p gu tai.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu kavɨk gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix maati'.
Gu' gu' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx pai' gu tukgam gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ba'p bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba' chulhiiñ cham jix búup gook mui'kim.
Na gu' na gu' na ja'p jo'ii' kapbhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p dhi' jix bhuup.
Jano' ba' tu' jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios cham bhai' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨpi'ñka' ka't gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam tu' gu ñi'ook cham tu'.
Na gu' na gu' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't oi'ñdha' gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios dhi' tukga'n; na gu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu kakkavɨk tɨɨt jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu Kelebra gu ñi'ook gu Judaa; na gu' cham pai' dhuuk tu'; jano' ba' bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'; gio ba' jix nukadham gu kavɨk gu bhóogɨt jix jai' gu kavɨk.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jakob na ja'p gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel; na gu'.
Jano' ba' kutun kavɨk jix kavɨk ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' na ja'p gu tai; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p; mi' dhɨr na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr vaak jodai iiñat.
Jano' ba' kiki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' jix aa'ñdhix jix duñia' na ja'p giokda'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Niinibe gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook namkɨm bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' kɨkbok bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' pai' maavɨt cham ka't ɨɨbhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' maavɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' kuubh gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' cham pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu ɨ'ɨr bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim gu ñi'ook; gio ba' kavaayo.
Jano' ba' gu Kaballero gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii u'u kavɨk; gio ba' koko'kam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duu kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ganai' bi'iix chɨbɨɨp bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' xi'ɨraam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' na ja'p.
Jano' ba' ka't bɨx tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu Niinibe; mi' dhɨr chɨkka duukat tu' nuukdaidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tutkɨ gu No-amoon ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ mia'n gu suudai' ka't gu gɨ' suudai' vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu kavɨk gu Ejipto cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Put gu Libia jix bɨɨx duu u'ua'tɨdham.
Jano' ba' gio ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gio jix bɨɨx duu bɨx; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu chio'ñ mamai'chɨk bɨx jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gio ka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka'; gio ba' tu' gio gu kavɨk kuiñcha bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; na tu' gu chin tu' jugi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ka't na ja'p gu u'vɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' kiki'ñgob gu oidha' gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' na ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' ba'k bhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai tu' jix duñia' gu kuchii tu' na ja'p; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' jix duu da'a.
Jano' ba' chiñia' ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' bhai' gu tanoolh jix jɨɨpi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tas cham jix maati' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bipia'dam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria jix kavɨk; gio ba' gu ja'tkam ja'aa gu kakkavɨk cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'; na gu' bɨx gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu noobh bhaan tu' na gu' bhaan chɨkka cham gu ñi'ook.
